notes.title: Big Update Just Put Live!
notes.content:
Hey guys I just put an update live with some new stuff in it.

Changes:

     + Growth stages (coconut, prickly pear, berries, trees)
     + Pistol (dropped by Pirate Ghosts)
     + Bats drop bat wings.
     + Order and Chaos face masks (displays if you have buffs from temples)
     + Damage indicators on enemies.
     + Improved trade menu.
     + Improved UI appearance and usability.
     + Improved art (trees, crops, UI)
     + Telescope for locating the star systems of Order and Chaos.
     + Added sky gems.


I have played tested these changes as much as I can. I expect that I will have missed some things. Let me know if you run into any bugs. Contact me through my website. Thanks!

tags.feature: + Growth stages (coconut, prickly pear, berries, trees)
+ Order and Chaos face masks (displays if you have buffs from temples)
+ Telescope for locating the star systems of Order and Chaos.

notes.title: Update with Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hey guys just put a new update live! Thanks to all those who joined me as I live-streamed development and playtesting. If you missed out the video is still up. (https://www.twitch.tv/brandonhilde) 

Issues Fixed:
[list]
    [*]Storage Chest displays text correctly.
    [*]Storage Chest no longer looses stacked items.
    [*]Propulsive Landing tech preserves rocket correctly.
    [*]Wires and Paper produce three for one resource.
    [*]Fixed cursors changing color.
[/list]


I expect to have another larger update in two weeks time.

Thanks for your support so far!
